title: A brick coach house behind 1726 Prairie
items: The alley behind 1726 Prairie now has its two-storey brick building: 14 m along the alley and 11.7 m deep, with a fire wall on the lot line to the south and a window pair on its alley wall. Its outline, storeys, brick and window place come from the 1911 Sanborn sheet, which calls it a garage; in 1904 it is built as a stable and coach house, and Robinson's 1886 atlas shows a smaller frame building there instead, so its date is uncertain. The doors, loft hatch, other windows and roof come from the shared coach-house kit and are reconstructed.
